name: Switch-disconnector
summary: A switch-disconnector combines operational switching with an isolation function.
description: A switch-disconnector combines operational switching with an isolation function. Its designation should distinguish it from a disconnector that is not intended to interrupt load current.
readingNotes: Check both switching duty and the documented isolation function.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: A load-break switch is not automatically a switch-disconnector; isolation suitability must be documented.
